frame.label: Frame
frame.description: The bike's structure: tubes, rear dropouts, bottom bracket shell and head tube.

fork.label: Fork
fork.description: Holds the front wheel and turns with the handlebar; rigid or suspended.

headset.label: Headset
headset.description: The bearings that let the fork turn inside the frame's head tube.

wheel-front.label: Front wheel
wheel-front.description: Hub, spokes and rim of the front wheel.

wheel-rear.label: Rear wheel
wheel-rear.description: Hub, spokes and rim of the rear wheel, including the freehub body.

tire-front.label: Front tyre
tire-front.description: The tyre fitted to the front rim.

tire-rear.label: Rear tyre
tire-rear.description: The tyre fitted to the rear rim; it wears faster than the front one.

tube-front.label: Front inner tube
tube-front.description: The tube that holds the air inside the front tyre.

tube-rear.label: Rear inner tube
tube-rear.description: The tube that holds the air inside the rear tyre.

sealant.label: Tubeless sealant
sealant.description: The liquid that seals a tubeless setup and plugs small punctures.

bottom-bracket.label: Bottom bracket
bottom-bracket.description: The bearings the crank spindle turns in.

crankset.label: Crankset
crankset.description: The crank arms, their spindle and the chainrings.

chainring.label: Chainring
chainring.description: The toothed ring on the crankset that drives the chain.

chain.label: Chain
chain.description: Carries your effort from the chainring to the sprockets; it stretches as it wears.

belt.label: Belt
belt.description: Toothed belt that replaces the chain on some hub-geared bikes.

cassette.label: Cassette
cassette.description: The stack of rear sprockets that slides onto the freehub body.

freewheel.label: Freewheel
freewheel.description: Sprocket block threaded onto the hub, on 5- to 7-speed drivetrains.

rear-derailleur.label: Rear derailleur
rear-derailleur.description: Moves the chain from one sprocket to the next.

front-derailleur.label: Front derailleur
front-derailleur.description: Moves the chain between the chainrings.

shifter-right.label: Right shifter
shifter-right.description: Controls the rear gears (derailleur or hub).

internal-gear-hub.label: Internal gear hub
internal-gear-hub.description: Rear hub that holds every gear inside, out of the dirt.

shift-cables.label: Shift cables
shift-cables.description: Cables and housing between the shifters and the derailleurs or hub.

brake-lever-front.label: Front brake lever
brake-lever-front.description: The left lever: it operates the front brake.

brake-lever-rear.label: Rear brake lever
brake-lever-rear.description: The right lever: it operates the rear brake.

brake-caliper-front.label: Front brake caliper
brake-caliper-front.description: The disc caliper, or the rim-brake arms, at the front.

brake-caliper-rear.label: Rear brake caliper
brake-caliper-rear.description: The disc caliper, or the rim-brake arms, at the rear.

rotor-front.label: Front rotor
rotor-front.description: The brake rotor bolted to the front hub.

rotor-rear.label: Rear rotor
rotor-rear.description: The brake rotor bolted to the rear hub.

brake-pads-front.label: Front pads
brake-pads-front.description: Pads on a disc brake, brake shoes on a rim brake.

brake-pads-rear.label: Rear pads
brake-pads-rear.description: Pads on a disc brake, brake shoes on a rim brake.

brake-line-front.label: Front brake cable or hose
brake-line-front.description: Links lever and caliper: a cable if mechanical, a hose if hydraulic.

brake-line-rear.label: Rear brake cable or hose
brake-line-rear.description: Links lever and caliper: a cable if mechanical, a hose if hydraulic.

handlebar.label: Handlebar
handlebar.description: The bar you steer with: drop, flat, riser or swept.

stem.label: Stem
stem.description: Connects the handlebar to the fork steerer.

grips-or-tape.label: Bar tape or grips
grips-or-tape.description: Bar tape on a drop bar, grips on every other bar.

seatpost.label: Seatpost
seatpost.description: Holds the saddle in the seat tube; rigid or dropper.

seat-clamp.label: Seat clamp
seat-clamp.description: Clamps the seatpost at the top of the seat tube.

pedal-right.label: Right pedal
pedal-right.description: Normal thread, on the drive side.

rear-shock.label: Rear shock
rear-shock.description: The shock between the main frame and the rear triangle.

e-motor.label: Motor
e-motor.description: The assist motor, at the cranks or in the rear hub.

e-battery.label: Battery
e-battery.description: The battery that powers the motor.

mudguards.label: Mudguards
mudguards.description: Keep water and mud thrown by the wheels off you.

rack.label: Rack
rack.description: Rear carrier for panniers and baskets.

kickstand.label: Kickstand
kickstand.description: Keeps the bike upright when parked.

material.label: Material
material.help: What the frame is made of, often printed on a sticker or the seat tube.

rear-axle.label: Rear axle
rear-axle.help: The axle standard the rear dropouts take: width and clamping type.

bb-shell.label: Bottom bracket shell
bb-shell.help: The standard of the frame's bottom bracket shell, threaded or press-fit.

head-tube.label: Head tube
head-tube.help: The head tube standard: threaded 1", straight 1-1/8" or tapered.

seatpost-diameter.label: Seatpost diameter
seatpost-diameter.help: Engraved on the seatpost (27.2, 30.9, 31.6 mm…) or measured with calipers.

seat-clamp-diameter.label: Seat clamp diameter
seat-clamp-diameter.help: The outside diameter of the seat tube, where the clamp tightens.

brake-mount.label: Brake mount
brake-mount.help: How the caliper attaches: flat mount, post mount or IS (with an adapter).

max-rotor.label: Largest rotor
max-rotor.help: The largest rotor diameter the manufacturer allows.

max-tire-width.label: Widest tyre
max-tire-width.help: The widest tyre that fits with at least 4 mm of clearance.

hanger-standard.label: Derailleur hanger standard
hanger-standard.help: UDH is the universal hanger; any other hanger is specific to its frame.

belt-splitter.label: Belt splitter
belt-splitter.help: A belt cannot be opened, so the rear triangle must open to fit it.

axle.label: Axle
axle.help: The wheel's axle type: quick release, thru-axle or nuts.

steerer.label: Steerer
steerer.help: The fork tube that goes up through the head tube: threaded, straight or tapered.

travel-mm.label: Travel
travel-mm.help: How far the suspension moves, in millimetres.

spring.label: Spring
spring.help: Steel coil spring, or an air spring set with a shock pump.

stanchion-mm.label: Stanchion diameter
stanchion-mm.help: The diameter of the fork's shiny upper tubes.

lockout.label: Lockout
lockout.help: A lever or dial that makes the suspension nearly rigid.

etrto-diameter.label: ETRTO diameter
etrto-diameter.help: The three-digit number after the dash on the tyre sidewall (622, 584…).

rim-width.label: Inner rim width
rim-width.help: Printed on the rim sticker (e.g. 622x19) or measured between the hooks.

rotor-interface.label: Hub rotor interface
rotor-interface.help: Six bolts or Centerlock (splines and a lockring) on the hub.

tubeless-ready.label: Tubeless ready
tubeless-ready.help: Marked "tubeless ready" or "TLR" on the rim or tyre.

freehub.label: Freehub body
freehub.help: The part of the hub the sprockets sit on: it decides which cassette fits.

etrto-width.label: Tyre width
etrto-width.help: The number before the dash on the sidewall (28-622 = 28 mm).

tread.label: Tread
tread.help: Smooth for the road, knobs for the trail.

valve.label: Valve
valve.help: Presta (thin, with a lock nut), Schrader (car type) or Dunlop.

valve-length.label: Valve length
valve-length.help: The deeper the rim, the longer the valve has to be.

sealant-kind.label: Sealant type
sealant-kind.help: Latex based (seals better) or synthetic (dries out more slowly).

spindle.label: Spindle
spindle.help: The spindle type joining the crank arms to the bottom bracket or motor.

pedal-thread.label: Pedal thread
pedal-thread.help: 9/16" on nearly every bike, 1/2" on one-piece cranks.

chainrings.label: Chainrings
chainrings.help: Count the toothed rings next to the right crank arm.

crank-length.label: Crank length
crank-length.help: Engraved on the inside of the crank arm (170, 172.5, 175 mm…).

teeth.label: Teeth
teeth.help: Often engraved on the chainring; otherwise count the teeth.

speeds.label: Speeds
speeds.help: The number of rear sprockets, or of hub gears.

e-rated.label: E-bike rated chain
e-rated.help: A reinforced chain built for a motor's torque.

belt-line.label: Belt line
belt-line.help: CDX for sport, CDN for city riding; the two are not interchangeable.

belt-teeth.label: Belt teeth
belt-teeth.help: Printed on the belt; it sets its length.

largest-cog.label: Largest sprocket
largest-cog.help: The tooth count of the cassette's biggest sprocket.

brand.label: Brand
brand.help: The drivetrain brand, printed on the shifter or derailleur.

actuation.label: Actuation
actuation.help: By cable (mechanical), by fluid (hydraulic) or electronic.

max-cog.label: Largest sprocket supported
max-cog.help: The largest sprocket the derailleur can reach, per the manufacturer.

clutch.label: Clutch
clutch.help: A switch or lever that tensions the chain and stops it slapping.

hanger-model.label: Hanger model
hanger-model.help: The hanger's part number, engraved on it or given by the frame brand.

fd-mount.label: Front derailleur mount
fd-mount.help: Welded tab (braze-on), a clamp around the tube, or direct mount.

shifter-type.label: Shifter type
shifter-type.help: Integrated brake lever, triggers, twist grip, thumb, bar-end or electronic.

positions.label: Positions
positions.help: How many chainrings the left shifter can select.

routing.label: Cable routing
routing.help: Outside the frame or inside the tubes.

pull.label: Cable pull
pull.help: How much cable the lever pulls: road (short), V-brake (long) or hydraulic.

integrated.label: Integrated lever
integrated.help: The brake lever also shifts gears.

brake-type.label: Brake type
brake-type.help: Rim caliper, V-brake, cantilever, mechanical or hydraulic disc.

mount.label: Caliper mount
mount.help: The caliper body: flat mount (bolts from below) or post mount (two vertical bolts).

adapter.label: Adapter
adapter.help: The bracket between caliper and frame that allows a bigger rotor.

rotor-size.label: Caliper rotor size
rotor-size.help: The rotor diameter the caliper is positioned for.

pad-type.label: Pad compound
pad-type.help: Resin (quiet), sintered metal (long-lasting), or rim-brake shoes.

piston-count.label: Pistons
piston-count.help: Two pistons on most brakes, four for more power.

fluid.label: Brake fluid
fluid.help: Mineral oil (Shimano…) or DOT (SRAM…): never mix the two.

interface.label: Mounting
interface.help: Six bolts or Centerlock: must match the hub.

pad-model.label: Pad model
pad-model.help: The manufacturer's reference, on the box or the back of the pad.

pad-thickness.label: Pad thickness
pad-thickness.help: Replace below 1 mm of pad material on a disc brake.

kind.label: Line type
kind.help: Cable in housing (mechanical) or fluid-filled hose (hydraulic).

bar-shape.label: Bar shape
bar-shape.help: Drop, flat, riser or swept back towards you.

bar-clamp.label: Bar clamp diameter
bar-clamp.help: The bar's diameter at its centre (25.4, 31.8 or 35 mm).

bar-width.label: Bar width
bar-width.help: End to end, or centre to centre on a drop bar.

steerer-clamp.label: Steerer clamp
steerer-clamp.help: Quill stem (older or kids' bikes) or a 1-1/8" stem.

stem-length.label: Stem length
stem-length.help: Measured from the steerer's centre to the bar's centre.

cover.label: Cover
cover.help: Wrapped tape on a drop bar, grips on the others.

saddle-width.label: Saddle width
saddle-width.help: Chosen from the distance between your sit bones.

rail.label: Rails
rail.help: Round 7 mm on most saddles, oval 7x9 mm on carbon ones.

dropper.label: Dropper
dropper.help: A bar remote lowers the saddle while riding.

quick-release.label: Quick release
quick-release.help: A lever rather than a bolt to set the saddle height.

pedal-type.label: Pedal type
pedal-type.help: Flat, SPD, road clipless, toe clips or combo.

cleat.label: Cleat
cleat.help: The cleat bolted under the shoe, which must match the pedal.

shock-mount.label: Shock mount
shock-mount.help: Standard eyelet, or trunnion (mounted by the body).

eye-to-eye.label: Eye-to-eye
eye-to-eye.help: The distance between the centres of the shock's two mounts.

stroke.label: Stroke
stroke.help: How far the shock itself can compress.

motor-brand.label: Motor brand
motor-brand.help: Printed on the motor casing or shown on the display.

crank-interface.label: Crank interface
crank-interface.help: The motor spindle's splines: specific to each brand.

torque.label: Torque
torque.help: The motor's maximum torque, in newton-metres.

battery-position.label: Battery position
battery-position.help: Inside the down tube, bolted on it, or on the rack.

capacity.label: Capacity
capacity.help: Printed on the battery label, in watt-hours.

voltage.label: Voltage
voltage.help: Printed on the battery label (usually 36 V).

mudguard-width.label: Mudguard width
mudguard-width.help: At least 10 mm wider than the tyre.

rack-mount.label: Rack mount
rack-mount.help: On the frame eyelets, or clamped to the seatpost.

kickstand-mount.label: Kickstand mount
kickstand-mount.help: Chainstay plate, centre mount or rear axle.

light-power.label: Power source
light-power.help: Batteries, a hub dynamo, or the e-bike's battery.

saddle-height.label: Saddle height
saddle-height.help: From the centre of the bottom bracket to the top of the saddle, along the seat tube.

saddle-setback.label: Saddle setback
saddle-setback.help: The horizontal distance between the saddle nose and the bottom bracket.

reach.label: Reach
reach.help: The horizontal distance from the saddle to where your hands rest on the bar.

bar-drop.label: Saddle-to-bar drop
bar-drop.help: The height of the saddle top minus the height of the handlebar.

cleat-position.label: Cleat position
cleat-position.help: Where to set the cleat so the ball of the foot sits over the pedal axle.

tire-pressure.label: Tyre pressure
tire-pressure.help: The pressure for your weight, the tyre width and a tubeless or tubed setup.

sag.label: Sag
sag.help: How far the suspension sinks with you on the bike, as a share of its travel.

chain-wear.label: Chain wear
chain-wear.help: How much the chain has stretched, measured with a checker or a ruler over 12 links.
